author: CRIMELINES
quote:
The only redeeming quality the game has as a GTA title is its amazing graphics, even though it has been in production since 2019 with a $2 billion budget..

It is the worst game in the franchise by far. It feels like a standalone spin-off and is completely out of touch with the GTA blueprint—basically an overhyped couple simulator. If you still intend on playing, make sure you rush through Chapter 1, because it is a snooze fest. 

Aside from the horrible story, the game is locked at 30 FPS. People might argue that Red Dead Redemption 2 was also 30 FPS, but that game literally released in 2018 and is a slow-paced game where you ride horses! In GTA, you drive fast cars, hell, even jets. The game literally feels like it's in slow motion and has severe input latency; it hurt my eyes to watch.

For the most anticipated and overhyped game of all time this is arguable worse than cyberpunk on launch, well played Rockstar.
